description:
We founded Zainab’s Closest with one simple goal: To help you find the Islamic apparel you need using the ease and convenience of a single platform. 

We believe that every Muslim woman should be able to find the clothing she needs for day to day life without the hassle of jumping from store to store or from site to site.

Instead of offering our customers a generic collection of clothing that abides by Islamic Sharia, we carefully curate unique and highly rated pieces perfectly suited for all your daily and festive needs.We focus on items that get you excited about shopping again, as we believe buying online should always be fun!

We pull stock from a variety of stores all over the world bringing you a diverse selection of Islamic apparel and paraphernalia!

Welcome to Zainab's Closet! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

The following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or utilizing the Program, in other words both merchant (hereby referred to as “we” or “the Merchant”) and affiliate/s (hereby referred to as “you” or “the Affiliate/s”) who refer customers to use products or services offered by the merchant.

By participating in the Program, the Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any shape or form.


1. Approval/Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program Registration at our sole discretion. The affiliate will have no legal recourse against the Merchant for the rejection of an Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

The Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on a different Affiliate's referral link and later clicks on yours to correct the first selection, the latter selection is counted.

Affiliate may or may not be assigned one coupon code with details and usage clarified on the Dashboard. If a customer clicks on the affiliate link and also uses the coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you are not assigned a branded coupon, then you may not promote the coupon.

The Affiliate may also advertise the Merchant's website through online channels such as Facebook, Instagram, Twitter,etc. or through offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

When you refer any customer to make a purchase on the Merchant's website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value, not including extra fees (such as tax, shipping costs, etc).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, the Affiliate will need to specify payment details in Settings. Payment scheduling will be detailed on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be disbursed for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives the Merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission is displayed in the Commissions tab, and any paid commission will be listed in the Payments tab. Transactions that result in charge-backs or refunds will not apply for commission disbursement.


4. Marketing Tool

We may share promotion media such as banners, logos or specific collection promotions to you through the Marketing tool tab. You may download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share it on your respective affiliate channels.


5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, an affiliate can invite others to become their own down-the-line Affiliate. If any down-the-line Affiliate (hereby referred to as a "DL Affiliate") brings an order to the Merchant, the up-the-line affiliate (hereby reffered to as a "UL Affiliate") will also recieve a network commission, dependent on Merchant Commission rates.

To invite other Affiliates into the system, share your network link, and any affiliate who clicks the link and completes the sign up process will become your DL Affiliate.


6. Cookies

We use cookies to track people who have clicked on an Affiliate's link, so a person must be using cookies for us to successfully track them.

If a person does not allow cookies or clears their cookies, we will not be able to track them and can not pay out any commission on said person's activity.

Cookie Tracking is shown on the Affiliate registration form. The date of tracking starts from the moment a customer clicks on an Affiliate’s link or uses their coupon. Within the Cookie Tracking Time Period, every order made by the customer on the Merchant's website will automatically result in a commission to the Affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the Affiliate link again).


7. Removal from the Program

If an Affiliate wishes to be removed from the Affiliate Program, they can request the removal by contacting: zainabscloset@gmail.com and entering the subject line: Removal From Affiliate Program.


Go Forward and Refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best! You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions in the future, and if you have any questions at all, you can send an email over to us at zainabscloset@gmail.com for support.
